title: Source Mode and Transactional Installation
rawUserRequest: 继续执行全面整改计划的 WI-03：实现 Source Mode、安装前检查、事务写入、ownership/symlink/path traversal、回滚与锁，并完成完整 PR、合并、关闭、分支清理和文档对齐流程。

rawRequestSource.reference: user-request: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction and continuation authorization

declaredIntent.summary: Make source classification and installation writes explicit, preflighted, transactional and recoverable.

outOfScope: Full Task Outcome/Status/PR integration (WI-09 and later)

sources.reason: Defines WI-03 source modes, write-plan, rollback, concurrency and dry-run acceptance.
Existing installer write boundary and ownership implementation.

riskAssessment.reason: Installer writes and source classification can damage adopter repositories if path, ownership, rollback or lock boundaries are incomplete; verification remains local/test-only.

executionDecision.reason: WI-02 is merged and closed; user authorized serial execution and WI-03 is bounded to installer/source/transaction behavior and tests.

preReviewWarnings: Review dirty/custom/unknown source modes, write-plan completeness, symlink/traversal ownership, rollback, locks and dry-run mutation snapshots.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Source Mode classification distinguishes verified release, clean/dirty local, custom/private/unknown source and blocks unknown source.
All installer writes are represented in a write plan and reject unmanaged ownership, symlink traversal and path traversal.
Failed writes restore files/branch state, concurrent writers are serialized or fail safely, and dry-run leaves no repository mutation.
Focused installer boundary tests and all required AI/project checks pass before PR creation.
The plan WI-03 section lists the implementation paths, verification matrix and downstream calibration boundary.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: Installation is a repository mutation boundary. Without explicit source mode, preflight write plan, ownership/path checks and recoverable transaction semantics, a dirty or untrusted source can be mistaken for a release and a failed install can leave partial state.
constraints: Keep release verification separate from local/custom source modes.
Do not follow untrusted symlinks or write outside managed paths.
Use local temporary repositories and fixtures for destructive/rollback tests; do not mutate external adopter repositories.
intent.rationale: A fail-closed installer boundary prevents partial writes and false release claims before later adoption and calibration work consumes installation evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Dirty/custom/unknown source modes classify explicitly and unknown source stops
Symlink, traversal, ownership and unmanaged file writes are rejected
Dry-run and failed transaction leave repository state unchanged

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.
